intro:

To emerge victorious, you'll need to balance your speed with your health, making quick decisions to pull your opponent towards you without getting too close to the deadly zone. With its simple controls and easy-to-learn gameplay, Drunken Tug War is perfect for players of all ages and skill levels who are looking for a fun and challenging experience.
